blueprints.name: Frontend Developer
blueprints.description: Builds and iterates on UI components, pages, and client-side logic using modern frontend frameworks with pixel-perfect precision and performance obsession.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to scaffold a new page, fix a UI bug, implement a design from Figma, refactor frontend components, or optimize Core Web Vitals.

blueprints.name: DevOps Automator
blueprints.description: Automates CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment workflows with a relentless focus on reliability and security.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to set up GitHub Actions, configure Docker builds, write Terraform, troubleshoot deployment failures, or optimize cloud infrastructure costs.

blueprints.name: UX Researcher
blueprints.description: Validates design decisions with real user data through structured research methodologies — user interviews, usability testing, persona creation, and heuristic evaluation.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to validate a design hypothesis, plan a usability study, create research-backed personas, conduct heuristic evaluation, or synthesize user feedback into actionable insights.

blueprints.name: Content Creator
blueprints.description: Produces blog posts, social copy, newsletters, video scripts, and marketing collateral aligned with brand voice across all digital channels.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to draft a blog post, write social media copy, create email campaigns, plan an editorial calendar, or repurpose existing content for new channels.

blueprints.name: Growth Hacker
blueprints.description: Finds the growth channel nobody has exploited yet — then scales it. Data-driven experimentation, funnel optimization, viral mechanics, and product-led growth.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to design growth experiments, optimize conversion funnels, build referral programs, reduce CAC, improve activation and retention rates, or identify scalable acquisition channels.

blueprints.name: Sales Coach
blueprints.description: Asks the question that makes the rep rethink the entire deal. Pipeline review facilitation, call coaching, deal strategy, and rep development through structured Socratic methodology.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to coach a sales rep on deal strategy, review a pipeline, debrief a sales call, design a rep development plan, or improve forecast accuracy through coaching discipline.

blueprints.name: Pipeline Analyst
blueprints.description: Tells you your forecast is wrong before you realize it yourself. Pipeline health diagnostics, deal velocity analysis, forecast accuracy, and data-driven intervention recommendations.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to diagnose pipeline health, build a revenue forecast, score deal quality, analyze stage conversion rates, identify at-risk deals, or provide data-backed pipeline intervention recommendations.

blueprints.name: Sprint Prioritizer
blueprints.description: Prioritizes backlog items using RICE, MoSCoW, and weighted scoring frameworks to maximize sprint value through data-driven decisions.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to triage a backlog, decide what goes into the next sprint, resolve conflicting stakeholder priorities, or plan capacity across teams.

blueprints.name: Senior Project Manager
blueprints.description: Converts specs to tasks with realistic scope — no gold-plating, no fantasy. Full project lifecycle from requirements through delivery, focused on scope discipline.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to break a specification into actionable tasks, plan a project timeline, manage scope and risk, communicate status to stakeholders, or create structured development task lists from requirements.

blueprints.name: Reality Checker
blueprints.description: Stops fantasy approvals with evidence-based certification. Defaults to NEEDS WORK, requires overwhelming proof for production readiness through QA and regression testing.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need a final quality gate before production, want to validate QA claims against reality, discover edge cases, plan a test strategy, or need honest bug reporting with evidence.

blueprints.name: Support Responder
blueprints.description: Customer support specialist for issue resolution and user experience optimization. Multi-channel support, proactive care, and turning interactions into positive brand experiences.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to triage support tickets, draft customer responses, manage escalations, build knowledge base articles, or design customer support workflows and SLA frameworks.

blueprints.name: Executive Summary Generator
blueprints.description: Transforms complex business inputs into concise, actionable executive summaries using McKinsey SCQA, BCG Pyramid Principle, and Bain frameworks for C-suite decision-makers.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to generate executive summaries, leadership status reports, risk highlights, KPI dashboards, or board deck content from complex business data.

blueprints.name: visionOS Spatial Engineer
blueprints.description: Native visionOS spatial computing specialist building SwiftUI volumetric interfaces, Liquid Glass experiences, and immersive applications for Apple Vision Pro using RealityKit and ARKit.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to build visionOS applications, design spatial UI with volumetric windows, implement Liquid Glass materials, create immersive experiences, or optimize RealityKit rendering for Apple Vision Pro.

blueprints.name: PPC Campaign Strategist
blueprints.description: Senior paid media strategist for search, shopping, and Performance Max campaigns across Google, Microsoft, and Amazon. Designs account structures and bidding strategies at scale.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to build or restructure PPC accounts, plan keyword strategy, optimize bidding, allocate budgets across campaigns, write ad copy, analyze ROAS, or design cross-platform paid media strategies.

blueprints.name: ZK Steward
blueprints.description: Knowledge-base steward in the spirit of Niklas Luhmann's Zettelkasten. Enforces atomic notes, connectivity, and validation loops. Switches to domain experts by task for cross-domain decision support.
blueprints.when_to_use: When building or maintaining a personal knowledge base with atomic notes and explicit linking, breaking down complex tasks into knowledge network entries, or needing cross-domain expert perspectives on research and analysis.

blueprints.name: Automation Governance Architect
blueprints.description: Governance-first architect for business automations who audits value, risk, and maintainability before implementation. Default stack is n8n, but governance rules are platform-agnostic.
blueprints.when_to_use: When evaluating whether a process should be automated, designing automation architectures with proper safeguards, auditing existing automations for risk and reliability, or establishing automation governance standards.

blueprints.name: Xiaohongshu Specialist
blueprints.description: Xiaohongshu (小红书/RED) marketing specialist focused on lifestyle content, trend-driven strategies, aesthetic storytelling, and authentic community engagement.
blueprints.when_to_use: When creating content strategy for Xiaohongshu, optimizing note performance, planning KOL collaborations, building brand communities on RED, or analyzing platform-specific engagement metrics.

blueprints.name: Feishu Integration Developer
blueprints.description: Full-stack integration expert for Feishu (Lark) Open Platform — bots, message cards, approval workflows, Bitable, SSO, and mini programs for enterprise collaboration.
blueprints.when_to_use: When building Feishu bots, integrating approval workflows, syncing data with Bitable, implementing SSO with Feishu, developing Feishu mini programs, or architecting enterprise automation on the Feishu/Lark platform.

teams.name: China Content Engine
teams.description: End-to-end content production and distribution team optimized for the Chinese market, combining platform-native copywriting with growth strategy and multi-channel content repurposing.
teams.when_to_use: When launching or scaling a brand presence in China and you need coordinated content production across Xiaohongshu and other channels with growth experimentation baked in.

teams.name: Dev Squad
teams.description: Full-stack development team pairing frontend implementation with infrastructure and deployment automation for rapid feature delivery.
teams.when_to_use: When building and shipping features end-to-end, from UI implementation through CI/CD pipeline setup and production deployment.

teams.name: Startup MVP
teams.description: Lean team for rapid MVP development that balances speed with quality through built-in prioritization and critical review of technical decisions.
teams.when_to_use: When building an MVP under time pressure and you need disciplined scope control, fast implementation, and a sanity check before shipping.
